problem_description:

Each opportunity has six measurable properties: economic return in quantum credit units (QCU), temporal resource allocation in development cycles, financial capital expenditure in investment units, equipment utilization in hardware resource units, specialized expertise requirements in expert hours, and computational load consumption in server capacity units. The investment matrix operates under five dimensional stability constraints: maximum temporal resource allocation of 280 development cycles, financial capital budget limit of 300 investment units, equipment utilization threshold of 250 hardware resource units, specialized expertise availability of 280 expert hours, and computational load capacity of 260 server capacity units. from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
import json

def main():
    opportunities = [
        ("Quantum Algorithm Optimizer", 85, 17, 14, 14, 13, 17),
        ("Neural Network Synthesizer", 98, 17, 13, 14, 17, 17),
        ("Blockchain Protocol Implementation", 15, 19, 18, 13, 17, 19),
        ("AI Model Training", 68, 18, 15, 16, 17, 17),
        ("Cloud Infrastructure", 13, 13, 18, 19, 14, 14),
        ("Edge Computing Platform", 93, 18, 14, 19, 19, 18),
        ("Distributed Ledger System", 100, 17, 15, 15, 15, 15),
        ("Machine Learning Pipeline", 59, 19, 17, 16, 16, 13),
        ("Data Analytics Engine", 52, 15, 18, 13, 14, 14),
        ("IoT Integration Framework", 19, 16, 19, 16, 19, 19),
        ("API Gateway Service", 30, 16, 15, 14, 15, 17),
        ("Security Audit Suite", 70, 15, 13, 16, 17, 16),
        ("Predictive Analytics", 83, 17, 13, 16, 13, 17),
        ("Autonomous System", 86, 17, 15, 19, 17, 14),
        ("Robotic Process Automation", 91, 14, 19, 19, 18, 18),
        ("Smart Contract Platform", 68, 13, 14, 15, 19, 19),
        ("Virtual Reality Engine", 11, 14, 13, 15, 14, 16),
        ("Quantum Sensor Network", 70, 16, 16, 15, 18, 17),
        ("Augmented Reality Interface", 100, 18, 18, 19, 16, 16),
        ("Biometric Security System", 15, 19, 17, 17, 15, 17),
        ("Voice Assistant", 92, 15, 15, 13, 19, 14),
        ("Cyber Defense Shield", 28, 16, 13, 16, 14, 13),
        ("Quantum Encryption Service", 31, 16, 13, 13, 16, 19),
        ("Edge Analytics Node", 76, 17, 15, 17, 16, 19),
        ("Microservice Architecture", 63, 17, 19, 16, 16, 14),
        ("Serverless Function Platform", 56, 14, 14, 19, 14, 18),
        ("Container Orchestration", 39, 13, 13, 15, 13, 19),
        ("DevOps Automation", 34, 14, 16, 15, 17, 19),
        ("Continuous Integration Pipeline", 58, 16, 18, 19, 19, 19),
        ("Multi-Cloud Strategy", 15, 18, 17, 15, 13, 13),
        ("Digital Twin Platform", 74, 19, 14, 13, 16, 17),
        ("Quantum Computing Cluster", 70, 17, 13, 19, 19, 16),
        ("Federated Learning Network", 13, 15, 13, 14, 16, 17),
        ("Big Data Processing", 95, 13, 19, 17, 18, 14),
        ("Natural Language Processor", 85, 13, 14, 16, 15, 17),
        ("Computer Vision System", 23, 15, 18, 16, 17, 16),
        ("Speech Recognition Engine", 16, 15, 15, 16, 14, 19),
        ("Graph Database Engine", 48, 19, 18, 19, 19, 13),
        ("Recommendation System", 85, 19, 18, 19, 19, 13),
        ("Anomaly Detection", 79, 17, 18, 19, 19, 16),
        ("Threat Intelligence Platform", 21, 13, 14, 13, 16, 17),
        ("Zero-Knowledge Proof", 17, 15, 13, 19, 13, 14),
        ("Smart Contract Executor", 79, 15, 18, 14, 16, 13),
        ("Privacy Preserving Analytics", 31, 13, 15, 17, 18, 19),
        ("Distributed Consensus", 70, 13, 18, 16, 15, 13),
        ("Load Balancer", 93, 19, 15, 17, 17, 19),
        ("Fault Tolerant System", 81, 18, 13, 16, 14, 16),
        ("Data Lake Architecture", 40, 17, 18, 17, 19, 17),
        ("Knowledge Graph Builder", 21, 13, 19, 19, 13, 16),
        ("Real-time Analytics", 55, 15, 19, 14, 17, 17),
        ("Stream Processing Engine", 51, 17, 16, 19, 14, 19),
        ("Event-Driven Architecture", 28, 14, 18, 14, 13, 17),
        ("Time Series Forecaster", 28, 16, 15, 14, 16, 15),
        ("Autonomous Agent Network", 37, 13, 17, 19, 19, 14),
        ("Quantum Communication Mesh", 42, 16, 12, 16, 14, 13),
        ("Bio-inspired Computing", 37, 19, 18, 13, 18, 19),
        ("Hybrid Intelligence System", 75, 13, 17, 17, 19, 16),
        ("Cognitive Computing Engine", 99, 14, 19, 14, 19, 17),
        ("Neural Processing Core", 52, 13, 17, 13, 19, 13),
        ("Quantum Interface Framework", 85, 17, 19, 14, 19, 19)
    ]
    
    n = len(opportunities)
    
    returns = [opp[1] for opp in opportunities]
    cycles = [opp[2] for opp in opportunities]
    capitals = [opp[3] for opp in opportunities]
    hardwares = [opp[4] for opp in opportunities]
    expertises = [opp[5] for opp in opportunities]
    loads = [opp[6] for opp in opportunities]
    
    max_cycles = 280
    max_capital = 300
    max_hardware = 250
    max_expertise = 280
    max_load = 260
    
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    x = [model.NewBoolVar(f"x[{i}]") for i in range(n)]
    
    model.Add(sum(cycles[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= max_cycles)
    
    model.Add(sum(capitals[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= max_capital)
    
    model.Add(sum(hardwares[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= max_hardware)
    
    model.Add(sum(expertises[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= max_expertise)
    
    model.Add(sum(loads[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)) <= max_load)
    
    model.Maximize(sum(returns[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)))
    
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 30.0
    solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 8
    
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status in (cp_model.OPTIMAL, cp_model.FEASIBLE):
        selected = [solver.Value(x[i]) for i in range(n)]
        total_return = sum(returns[i] * selected[i] for i in range(n))
        total_cycles = sum(cycles[i] * selected[i] for i in range(n))
        total_capital = sum(capitals[i] * selected[i] for i in range(n))
        total_hardware = sum(hardwares[i] * selected[i] for i in range(n))
        total_expertise = sum(expertises[i] * selected[i] for i in range(n))
        total_load = sum(loads[i] * selected[i] for i in range(n))
        
        print(json.dumps({
            "selected": selected,
            "total_return": total_return,
            "total_cycles": total_cycles,
            "total_capital": total_capital,
            "total_hardware": total_hardware,
            "total_expertise": total_expertise,
            "total_load": total_load
        }))
    else:
        print(f"No solution found. Status: {solver.StatusName(status)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
